product_brief: ETAS offers robust, cutting-edge PQC algorithms and expert guidance to help OEMs transition automotive systems to quantum-secure solutions.
pqc_capability_description: ETAS provides specific technical quantum-safe solutions, analyzing systems using asymmetric cryptography to identify migration changes. They design migration solutions for PKI and key management, analyze PQC algorithms for key/signature sizes, performance, and memory consumption, and compare resources of deployed ECUs with benchmarks. They are developing a quantum-resistant PKI in the FLOQI project.
key_management_model: Design of migration and transition solutions for key management; analysis of PKI changes.
pqc_roadmap_details: ETAS provides guidance for management, including workshops, recommendations on points of action, prioritization, and timeline establishment. They analyze current standardization activities for post-quantum algorithms.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Analysis of PQC algorithms with respect to key and signature sizes, performance of specific operations, and memory consumption; comparison of resources of deployed ECUs with available benchmarks to identify suitable algorithms for different targets/use cases.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: ETAS designs migration and transition solutions, for example for the PKI or key management. They analyze specific systems to identify changes necessary for migration, taking specific requirements into consideration.
organizational_readiness: ETAS offers customer workshops to raise awareness, gives specific recommendations on points of action and prioritization, and helps establish a timeline.
